Нет: польза зависит от того, гасит ли си: No: the benefit depends on whether the system damps deviations by itself, and the chunk also gets through the operator's pauses
В интерактиве с 200 прогонами при λ > 1: In the 200-run interactive, at λ > 1 the chunk hurt even though there were just as few decisions. And in the lab the chunk got through the pause where the per-step policy got stuck.
ACT выдаёт пачку из 100 действий за 100: Does ACT output a chunk of 100 actions in 100 network passes, one action per pass?
Да, как языковая модель выдаёт слова: Yes, the way a language model emits words
Нет: 100 запросов декодера считаются одн: No: the decoder's 100 queries are computed simultaneously, and the whole chunk comes out in one pass
Нет: пачку уточняют из шума за 10–16 шаг: No: the chunk is refined from noise in 10–16 denoising steps
Запросы декодера не ждут друг друга: каж: The decoder's queries don't wait for one another: each one takes information from the camera, joint and z tokens through attention and assembles its action. That's why inference takes about 10 ms and ACT can be queried at every step. It was Diffusion Policy in lesson 1.5 that refined the chunk from noise.
у каждой демонстрации своя манера: each demonstration has its own style
оператор 2 объезжает справа: operator 2 goes around on the right
оператор 1 объезжает слева: operator 1 goes around on the left
β·KL — плата за отличие от N(0, 1): β·KL: the price of differing from N(0, 1)
одна и та же пачка в каждом прогоне:: the same chunk in every run:
Нет: больше всего весят самые старые пре: No: the oldest predictions weigh the most
В коде ACT веса убывают от самой старой: In the ACT code the weights decrease from the oldest chunk to the freshest, so older predictions weigh more. For fresh ones to weigh more, m has to be made negative, as in the section on blending chunks.
Да: чем меньше решений, тем меньше накап: Yes: the fewer decisions, the less error accumulates
Нет: длинная пачка проходит паузы, но до: No: a long chunk gets through pauses, but it goes longer without new frames and reacts late to the unexpected
Да, если модель достаточно большая: Yes, if the model is large enough
У длины пачки есть окно: короткие застре: Chunk length has a window: short chunks get stuck at pauses, long ones react late to the unexpected. In the lab the window was 14 to 25 actions. That is why large systems execute only part of the chunk, for example π0 runs 25 actions out of 50.
Нет: они исполняют часть пачки и склеива: No: they execute part of the chunk and join the seams, and blending chunks made things worse, for example in π0
L1 вместо MSE решает проблему разных ман: Does L1 instead of MSE solve the problem of different operator styles?
Да: L1 не усредняет, значит, противоречи: Yes: L1 doesn't average, so there's no conflict anymore
Нет: L1 не ведёт в вазу, а берёт сторону: No: L1 doesn't lead into the vase, it takes the side with more demonstrations, but the different styles in the data still demand different chunks
Нет: L1 тоже усредняет и ведёт прямо в в: No: L1 averages too and leads straight into the vase
Медиана выбирает одну сторону, но на одн: The median picks one side, but for the same frame the demonstrations still demand different chunks from the network. That is why the ACT authors added a hint about the style during training: the CVAE.
Асинхронный вывод убирает и паузы, и ска: Does asynchronous inference remove both pauses and jumps at the seams between chunks?
Да: пачку считают заранее, и робот не жд: Yes: the chunk is computed in advance, and the robot doesn't wait
Нет: пауз нет, но новая пачка посчитана: No: there are no pauses, but the new chunk is computed from an outdated frame and may start away from where the robot is, so there can be a jump at the seam
Без скачка пачки склеивает Real-Time Chu: Real-Time Chunking joins chunks without a jump: the actions that will be executed during inference are frozen, and the rest are inpainted so that the new chunk continues the old one.
L1: пачка совпала\\nс траекторией операт: L1: the chunk matches\nthe operator's trajectory
траектории оператора нет, энкодер не нуж: no operator's trajectory, so no encoder
